{{Quote|For bravery far beyond the call of duty, you have been awarded the Star of Alderaan. Magnificent flying, Azameen.|[[Zaletta]]|audio=ZalettaStarOfAlderaan-XWA.flac|<ref name="XWA" />}}
The '''Star of Alderaan''' was a citation granted by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] and named in honor of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]. The award commemorated the role played by Alderaan and its leader, [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Prestor Organa]], in the creation of the Alliance.

Established after the [[Destruction of Alderaan/Legends|destruction of Alderaan]] and presented by an [[Alderaanian/Legends|Alderaanian]] survivor, the Star of Alderaan was given for bravery in wartime operations when the action is thought insufficient to receive a [[Corellian Cross/Legends|Corellian Cross]]. [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]] defined its prerequisite as "a person who, while serving in any capacity in the Alliance military, is cited for gallantry in action against an enemy of the Alliance while engaged in military operations involving conflict with an opposing force, or while with friendly foreign forces in armed conflict with an enemy."

==Notable recipients==
Recipients include [[Keyan Farlander/Legends|Keyan Farlander]] for his efforts at the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], [[Kyle Katarn]] for ending the [[Dark Trooper/Legends|Dark Trooper]] project and [[Ace Azzameen/Legends|Ace Azzameen]] for his actions in the lead-up to the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]].<ref name="XWA" />
